headline: Brookfield to Acquire India's PGP Glass from Blackstone for $1.7 Billion
summary: Brookfield has agreed to acquire Indian glass packaging manufacturer PGP Glass from Blackstone in a $1.7 billion transaction spanning operations in India, Brazil, and the U.K.
why: Cross-border private equity transactions of this scale demonstrate ongoing institutional appetite for multinational packaging assets and industrial infrastructure.

impacts.name: Brookfield
impacts.why: Acquiring industrial assets expands the portfolio footprint of the alternative asset manager.
